o: Adam, Set, Enos,
t: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

o: Kainan, Mahalaleel, Járed,
t: Cainan, Mahalalel, Jared,

o: Enoch, Matuzalém, Lámech,
t: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

o: Noé, Sem, Cham a Jáfet.
t: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

o: Synové Jáfetovi: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Mešech a Tiras.
t: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

o: Synové pak Gomerovi: Ascenez, Difat a Togorma.
t: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphat, and Togarmah.

o: Synové pak Javanovi: Elisa, Tarsis, Cetim a Rodanim.
t: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

o: Synové Chamovi: Chus, Mizraim, Put a Kanán.
t: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.

o: A synové Chusovi: Sába, Evila, Sabata, Regma, Sabatacha. Synové pak Regmovi: Sába a Dedan.
t: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Regmah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Regmah: Sheba and Dedan.

o: Zplodil také Chus Nimroda; ten počal mocným býti na zemi.
t: He begat also Cush the son of Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.

o: Mizraim pak zplodil Ludim, Anamim, Laabim a Neftuim,
t: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Laabim, and Neftuhim,

o: Fetruzim také a Chasluim, (odkudž pošli Filistinští), a Kafturim.
t: and Phetrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

o: Kanán pak zplodil Sidona, prvorozeného svého, a Het,
t: and Canaan begot Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth,

o: A Jebuzea, Amorea a Gergezea,
t: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

o: A Hevea, Aracea a Sinea,
t: And Hephvah, Arameah, and Shephardiah,

o: A Aradia, Samarea a Amatea.
t: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites.

o: Synové Semovi: Elam, Assur, Arfaxad, Lud, Aram, Hus a Hul, Geter a Mas.
t: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Hus, and Hul, Gether, and Mash.

o: A Arfaxad zplodil Sále, Sále pak zplodil Hebera.
t: and Arphaxad begot Shelah, and Shelah begot Eber.

o: Heberovi pak narodili se dva synové, z nichž jednoho jméno Peleg, proto že za dnů jeho rozdělena byla země, jméno pak bratra jeho Jektan.
t: and to Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided; and the name of his brother was Joktan.

o: Kterýžto Jektan zplodil Elmodada, Salefa, Azarmota a Járe,
t: and Joktan begot Elmodad, Shelah, Hazarmoth, and Jereh,

o: A Adoráma, Uzala a Dikla,
t: And Hadoram, Uzzal, and Diklah,

o: A Ebale, Abimahele a Sebai,
t: And Eber, Abimelech, and Shemiram,

o: A Ofira, Evila a Jobaba. Všickni ti byli synové Jektanovi.
t: and Ophirah, and Helah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

o: Sem, Arfaxad, Sále,
t: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

o: Heber, Peleg, Réhu,
t: Heber, Peleg, Reu,

o: Sárug, Náchor, Táre,
t: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

o: Abram, ten jest Abraham.
t: Abram, that is, Abraham.

o: Synové Abrahamovi: Izák a Izmael.
t: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

o: Tito jsou rodové jejich: Prvorozený Izmaelův Nabajot, Cedar, Adbeel a Mabsan,
t: These are their descendants: Ishmael's firstborn, Naboth, Kedar, Adbeel, and Mibsam,

o: Masma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad a Tema,
t: Massa, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

o: Jetur, Nafis a Cedma. Ti jsou synové Izmaelovi.
t: and Jethur, Naphish, and Cedma. These are the sons of Ishmael.

o: Synové pak Cetury, ženiny Abrahamovy: Ta porodila Zamrana, Jeksana, Madana, Madiana, Jezbocha a Suecha. Synové pak Jeksanovi: Sába a Dedan.
t: and the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Median, Jethboah, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

o: Synové pak Madianovi: Efa, Efer, Enoch, Abida a Helda. Všickni ti synové Cetury.
t: and the sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Enoch, Abida, and Helda. All these were the sons of Keturah.

o: Zplodil tedy Abraham Izáka. Synové pak Izákovi: Ezau a Izrael.
t: Abraham begot Isaac. And the sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel (Jacob).

o: Synové Ezau: Elifaz, Rahuel, Jehus, Jhelom a Kore.
t: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

o: Synové Elifazovi: Teman, Omar, Sefi, Gatam, Kenaz a syn Tamny, totiž Amalech.
t: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatah, Kenaz, and the son of Timna, namely Amalek.

o: Synové Rahuelovi: Nahat, Zára, Samma a Méza.
t: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

o: Synové pak Seir: Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Dison, Eser a Dízan.
t: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Eser, and Dishan.

o: Synové pak Lotanovi: Hori a Homam. Sestra pak Lotanova: Tamna.
t: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Lotan's sister: Timna.

o: Synové Sobalovi: Alian, Manáhat, Ebal, Sefi a Onam. Synové pak Sebeonovi: Aia a Ana.
t: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

o: Synové Anovi: Dison. A synové Disonovi: Hamran, Eseban, Jetran a Charan.
t: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamram, Eshban, Jethran, and Charan.

o: Synové Eser: Balaan, Závan a Jakan. Synové Dízonovi: Hus a Aran.
t: The sons of Esher: Balan, Zavan, and Akan. The sons of Dishon: Hus and Shem.

o: Tito pak jsou králové, kteříž kralovali v zemi Idumejské, prvé než kraloval který král z synů Izraelských: Béla syn Beorův, jehožto město jméno mělo Denaba.
t: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned in Israel: Bela the son of Beor, whose city was called Danah.

o: A když umřel Béla, kraloval na místě jeho Jobab, syn Záre z Bozra.
t: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

o: A když umřel Jobab, kraloval místo něho Husam z země Temanské.
t: And when Jobab died, Husham from the land of Teman reigned in his place.

o: A když umřel Husam, kraloval místo něho Adad syn Badadův, kterýž porazil Madianské v krajině Moábské; jehož město jméno mělo Avith.
t: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad reigned in his place, who smote the Midianites in the field of Moab; his city was called Avith.

o: A když umřel Adad, kraloval na místě jeho Semla z Masreka.
t: And when Hadad died, Shemla from Masrekah reigned in his place.

o: A když umřel Semla, kraloval místo něho Saul z Rohobot řeky.
t: And when Shemla died, Saul from Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.

o: A když umřel Saul, kraloval místo něho Bálanan, syn Achoborův.
t: And when Saul died, Balanan the son of Ahobor reigned in his place.

o: A když umřel Bálanan, kraloval místo něho Adad, jehož město řečené Pahu; jméno pak ženy jeho Mehetabel, dcera Matredy, dcery Mezábovy.
t: And when Balanan died, Hadad reigned in his place, whose city was called Pah; and the name of his wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

o: A když umřel Adad, byli vývodové Idumejští: Vývoda Tamna, vývoda Alja, vývoda Jetet,
t: And when Hadad died, the chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

o: Vývoda Olibama, vývoda Ela, vývoda Finon,
t: The ruler of Obal, the ruler of Elah, the ruler of Pinon,

o: Vývoda Kenaz, vývoda Teman, vývoda Mabsar,
t: The ruler of Kenaz, the ruler of Teman, the ruler of Mabsar,

o: Vývoda Magdiel, vývoda Híram. Ti byli vývodové Idumejští.
t: chief Magdiel, chief Hiram. These were the chiefs of Edom.

o: Tito jsou synové Izraelovi: Ruben, Simeon, Léví, Juda, Izachar a Zabulon,
t: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

o: Dan, Jozef, Beniamin, Neftalím, Gád a Asser.
t: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

o: Synové Judovi: Her, Onan a Séla. Ti tři narodili se jemu z dcery Suovy Kananejské. Ale Her, prvorozený Judův, byl zlý před očima Hospodinovýma, protož zabil ho.
t: The sons of Judah were: Er, Onan, and Shelah. These three were born to him by Shuah the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord slew him.

o: Támar pak nevěsta jeho porodila mu Fáresa a Záru. Všech synů Judových pět.
t: Then Tamar his wife bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

o: Synové Fáresovi: Ezron a Hamul.
t: The sons of Phares: Esrom and Hamul.

o: Synové pak Záre: Zamri, Etan, Héman, Kalkol a Dára, všech těch pět.
t: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five in all.

o: A synové Zamri: Charmi, vnuk Achar, kterýž zkormoutil Izraele, zhřešiv při věci proklaté.
t: And the sons of Zimri: Charmai, the son of Achar, who troubled Israel, committing trespass in the matter of the forbidden thing.

o: Synové pak Etanovi: Azariáš.
t: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.

o: Synové pak Ezronovi, kteříž se mu zrodili: Jerachmeel, Ram a Chelubai.
t: And the sons of Ezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

o: Ram pak zplodil Aminadaba, a Aminadab zplodil Názona, kníže synů Juda.
t: And Ram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahash, prince of the sons of Judah.

o: Názon pak zplodil Salmona, a Salmon zplodil Bóza.
t: And Nahash begot Salmon, and Salmon begot Boaz.

o: A Bóz zplodil Obéda, a Obéd zplodil Izai.
t: And Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse.

o: Izai pak zplodil prvorozeného svého Eliaba, a Abinadaba druhého, a Sammu třetího,
t: And Jesse begot his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shammim the third,

o: Natanaele čtvrtého, Raddaia pátého,
t: Nathaniel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

o: Ozema šestého, Davida sedmého,
t: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh,

o: A sestry jejich: Sarvii a Abigail. Synové pak Sarvie byli: Abizai, Joáb, Azael, tři.
t: And their sisters: Serah and Abigail. And the sons of Serah were: Abishai, Joab, and Azarel, three.

o: Abigail pak porodila Amazu, otec pak Amazův byl Jeter Izmaelitský.
t: And Abigail bore Amazah, and the father of Amazah was Jether the Ishmaelite.

o: Kálef pak syn Ezronův zplodil s Azubou manželkou a s Jeriotou syny. Jehož tito synové byli: Jeser, Sobab a Ardon.
t: And Caleb the son of Ezron begot sons with Azubah his wife and with Jerioth. His sons were: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

o: Když pak umřela Azuba, pojal sobě Kálef Efratu, kteráž mu porodila Hura.
t: And when Azubah died, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, and she bore him Hur.

o: A Hur zplodil Uri, a Uri zplodil Bezeleele.
t: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezeliel.

o: Potom všel Ezron k dceři Machira otce Galádova, kterouž on pojal, když byl v šedesáti letech. I porodila jemu Seguba.
t: Then Ezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, and he took her, when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

o: Segub pak zplodil Jaira, kterýž měl třimecítma měst v zemi Galád.
t: And Segub begat Jair, who had thirty cities in the land of Gilead.

o: Nebo vzal Gessurejským a Assyrským vsi Jairovy, i Kanat s městečky jeho, šedesáte měst. To všecko pobrali synové Machirovi, otce Galádova.
t: For he took the villages of Jair from the Geshurites and the Syrians, with the towns thereof, sixty cities. All these did the sons of Machir the father of Gilead take.

o: Též i po smrti Ezronově, když již pojal byl Kálef Efratu, manželka Ezronova Abia porodila jemu také Ashura, otce Tekoa.
t: Also after the death of Ezron, when Caleb had already taken Ephrath, the wife of Ezron, Abiah, his wife, bore him also Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.

o: Byli pak synové Jerachmeele prvorozeného Ezronova: Prvorozený Ram, po něm Buna a Oren, a Ozem s Achia.
t: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Ezron were: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem with Ahijah.

o: Měl také manželku druhou Jerachmeel, jménem Atara. Ta jest matka Onamova.
t: He had also a second wife, named Atarah, who is the mother of Onam.

o: Byli pak synové Ramovi prvorozeného Jerachmeele: Maaz a Jamin a Eker.
t: And the sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

o: Též synové Onamovi byli: Sammai a Jáda. A synové Sammai: Nádab a Abisur.
t: And the sons of Onam were: Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

o: Jméno pak manželky Abisurovy Abichail; ktéráž porodila jemu Achbana a Molida.
t: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molad.

o: A synové Nádabovi: Seled a Appaim. Ale umřel Seled bez dětí.
t: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. But Seled died childless.

o: Synové pak Appaimovi: Jesi; a synové Jesi: Sesan; a dcera Sesanova: Achlai.
t: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi; and the sons of Ishi: Sheshan; and the daughter of Sheshan: Ahlai.

o: Synové pak Jády, bratra Sammaiova: Jeter a Jonatan. Ale umřel Jeter bez dětí.
t: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. But Jether died childless.

o: Synové pak Jonatanovi: Felet a Záza. Ti byli synové Jerachmeelovi.
t: And the sons of Jonathan: Phelet and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

o: Neměl pak Sesan synů, ale dceru. A měl Sesan služebníka Egyptského jménem Jarchu.
t: And Shesh had no sons, but a daughter. And Shesh had a servant, an Egyptian, named Jarneh.

o: Protož dal Sesan dceru svou Jarchovi služebníku svému za manželku, kteráž porodila mu Attaie.
t: For Sheshan gave his daughter Jarchah to his servant Jarrah in marriage, and she bore him Attai.

o: Attai pak zplodil Nátana, a Nátan zplodil Zabada.
t: Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad.

o: Zabad pak zplodil Eflale, a Eflal zplodil Obéda.
t: Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed.

o: Obéd pak zplodil Jéhu, a Jéhu zplodil Azariáše.
t: Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah.

o: Azariáš pak zplodil Cheleza, a Chelez zplodil Elasu.
t: Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Elasah.

o: Elasa pak zplodil Sismaie, a Sismai zplodil Salluma.
t: Elasah begot Shismai, and Shismai begot Shallum.

o: Sallum pak zplodil Jekamiáše, a Jekamiáš zplodil Elisama.
t: Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.

o: Synové pak Kálefa, bratra Jerachmeelova: Mésa prvorozený jeho. On byl otec Zifejských i synů Marese, otce Hebronova.
t: Now the sons of Caleb, brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn. He was the father of the Ziphites and of the sons of Maresh, the father of Hebron.

o: Synové pak Hebronovi: Chóre a Tapuach, a Rekem a Sema.
t: And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah, and Rechom and Shema.

o: Sema pak zplodil Rachama otce Jorkeamova, a Rekem zplodil Sammaie.
t: Shema begot Racham the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem begot Shammai.

o: Syn pak Sammai byl Maon; kterýžto Maon byl otec Betsurských.
t: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of the Beth-zurites.

o: Efa také, ženina Kálefova, porodila Chárana a Mozu a Gazeza. A Cháran zplodil Gazeza.
t: Ephah also, Caleb's wife, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez. And Haran begot Gazez.

o: Synové pak Johedai: Regem, Jotam, Gesan, Felet, Efa a Saaf.
t: And the sons of Jehdei: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ezer, and Shaaph.

o: S ženinou Maachou Kálef zplodil Sebera a Tirchana.
t: And Caleb by his wife Maacah begot Sheber and Tirchan.

o: Porodila pak Saafa otce Madmanejských, Sévu otce Makbenejských a otce Gibejských. Též dcera Kálefova Axa.
t: And she bore Shaaph the father of Madmannim, Sheth the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibeah; also Achsa, Caleb's daughter.

o: Ti byli synové Kálefovi, syna Hur prvorozeného Efraty: Sobal otec Kariatjeharimských,
t: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of the Kiriath-jearimites,

o: Salma otec Betlémských, Charef otec čeledi Betgaderských.
t: Salma the father of the Bethlehemites, Hareph the father of the house of the Gathites.

o: Měl pak syny Sobal otec Kariatjeharimských: Haroe otce obyvatelů dílu Menuchotských.
t: And Shobal the father of the Kiriath-jearimites had sons: Haroeh the father of the men of Menuchoth.

o: A čeledi Kariatjeharimských, Jeterských, Putských, Sumatských a Misraiských. Z těch pošli Zaratští a Estaolští.
t: And the families of the Kiriath-jearimites, the Jetherites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Misraites. From these came the Zareathites and the Eshtaulites.

o: Synové Salmy: Betlémští, Netofatští, Atarotští z čeledi Joábovy, a Zarští, kteříž užívali dílu Menuchotských,
t: The sons of Salma: the Bethlehemites, the Netophathites, the Atarothites of the house of Joab, and the Zareathites who used the portion of Menuchoth,

o: A čeledi písařů obývajících v Jábezu, Tiratských, Simatských, Suchatských. Ti jsou Cinejští příchozí z Amata, otce čeledi Rechabovy.
t: And the families of the scribes who dwelt in Jabez, the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Suchathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hamath, the father of the family of Rechab.

o: Tito jsou pak synové Davidovi, kteříž se jemu zrodili v Hebronu: Prvorozený Amnon z Achinoam Jezreelské, druhý Daniel z Abigail Karmelské;
t: Then these were the sons of David who were born to him at Hebron: Amnon his firstborn, of Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelite;

o: Třetí Absolon syn Maachy, dcery Tolmai, krále Gessur, čtvrtý Adoniáš, syn Haggit;
t: The third, Absalom his son, of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah his son, of Haggith;

o: Pátý Sefatiáš z Abitál, šestý Jetram, z Egly manželky jeho.
t: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Joram of Egah his wife.

o: Šest se mu jich zrodilo v Hebronu, kdež kraloval sedm let a šest měsíců; třidceti pak a tři kraloval v Jeruzalémě.
t: Six sons were born to him at Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months; and thirty-three years he reigned in Jerusalem.

o: Potom tito se jemu zrodili v Jeruzalémě: Sammua, Sobab, Nátan a Šalomoun, čtyři, z Betsabé, dcery Amielovy;
t: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathsheba the daughter of Amiel;

o: Též Ibchar, Elisama a Elifelet;
t: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

o: A Noga, Nefeg a Jafia;
t: And Nogah, Nepheg, and Japhiah;

o: A Elisama, Eliada a Elifelet, těch devět.
t: And Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine in all.

o: Všickni ti synové Davidovi krom synů ženin, a Támar sestra jejich.
t: All these were David's sons, besides the sons of his concubines, and Tamar their sister.

o: Syn pak Šalomounův Roboám, Abiam syn jeho, Aza syn jeho, Jozafat syn jeho,
t: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam; his son was Abijah; his son was Jehoshaphat;

o: Joram syn jeho, Ochoziáš syn jeho, Joas syn jeho,
t: His son was Joram; his son was Ahaziah; his son was Joash;

o: Amaziáš syn jeho, Azariáš syn jeho, Jotam syn jeho,
t: His son was Amaziah; his son was Azariah; his son was Jotham;

o: Achas syn jeho, Ezechiáš syn jeho, Manasses syn jeho,
t: His son was Ahaz; his son was Hezekiah; his son was Manasseh;

o: Amon syn jeho, Joziáš syn jeho.
t: His son was Amon; his son was Josiah.

o: Synové pak Joziášovi: Prvorozený Jochanan, druhý Joakim, třetí Sedechiáš, čtvrtý Sallum.
t: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

o: Synové pak Joakimovi: Jekoniáš syn jeho, Sedechiáš syn jeho.
t: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

o: Synové pak Jekoniáše vězně: Salatiel syn jeho.
t: And the sons of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son.

o: Toho pak Malkiram, Pedai, Senazar, Jekamia, Hosama a Nedabia.
t: And Malkiram, Pedaiah, Shenasar, Jeconiah, Hosham, and Nedabiah.

o: Synové pak Pedaiovi: Zorobábel a Semei. A syn Zorobábelův: Mesullam, Chananiáš, a Selomit sestra jejich.
t: Then the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And a son of Zerubbabel: Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.

o: Toho pak Chasuba, Ohel, Berechiáš, Chasadiáš a Jusabchesed, těch pět.
t: And of Hashubah: Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed, these five.

o: Syn pak Chananiášův: Pelatia a Izaiáš. Synové Refaie, synové Arnanovi, synové Abdiášovi, synové Sechaniovi.
t: And a son of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Isaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Abdiash, the sons of Shecaniah.

o: A synové Sechaniovi: Semaiáš. A synové Semaiášovi: Chattus, Igal, Bariach, Neariáš a Safat, šest.
t: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Baruch, Neariah, and Shephat, six.

o: A syn Neariáše: Elioenai, Ezechiáš a Azrikam, ti tři.
t: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam, these three.

o: Též synové Elioenai: Hodaviáš, Eliasib, Pelaiáš, Akkub, Jochanan, Delaiáš a Anani, těch sedm.
t: Also the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelatiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, these seven.

o: Synové Judovi: Fáres, Ezron, Charmi, Hur a Sobal.
t: The sons of Judah: Phares, Ezron, Charmi, Hur, and Shobal.

o: Reaiáš pak syn Sobalův zplodil Jachata, Jachat pak zplodil Ahumai a Laad. Ti jsou rodové Zarati.
t: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Laad. These are the families of the Zareathites.

o: A tito z otce Etama: Jezreel, Isma a Idbas; a jméno sestry jejich Zelelfoni.
t: And these, of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishmael, and Idbash; and the name of their sister Zelophehon.

o: Fanuel pak otec Gedor, a Ezer otec Chusův. Ti jsou synové Hur prvorozeného Efraty, otce Betlémských.
t: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Cush. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of the Bethlehemites.

o: Ashur pak otec Tekoe měl dvě manželky, Chélu a Naaru.
t: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Chelah and Naarah.

o: I porodila jemu Naara Achuzama, Hefera, Temana a Achastara. Ti jsou synové Naary.
t: Naara bore him Ahuzam, Hefer, Teman and Ahastari. These are the sons of Naarah.

o: Synové pak Chéle: Zeret, Jezochar a Etnan.
t: And the sons of Chelah: Zeret, Jezochar, and Ethnan.

o: Kóz pak zplodil Anuba, Hazobeba, a rodiny Acharchele syna Harumova.
t: Koz begot Anub, Hazobeb, and the families of Aharhele, son of Harum.

o: Byl pak Jábez slavnější nad bratří své, a matka jeho nazvala jméno jeho Jábez, řkuci: Nebo jsem ho porodila s bolestí.
t: Now Jabez was more renowned than his brothers, and his mother named his name Jabez, saying, "For I bore him in pain."

o: Kterýžto Jábez vzýval Boha Izraelského, řka: Jestliže štědře požehnáš mi, a rozšíříš meze mé, a bude ruka tvá se mnou, a vysvobodíš mne od zlého, abych bolesti netrpěl. I učinil Bůh, začež žádal.
t: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, "If You will richly bless me, and enlarge my border, and Your hand will be with me, and You will deliver me from evil, so that I may not suffer pain." So God granted him what he asked.

o: Chelub pak, bratr Sucha, zplodil Mechiru. Onť jest otec Estonův.
t: Chelub, brother of Shua, begot Mehir. He is the father of the Estonites.

o: Eston pak zplodil Betrafa, Paseacha a Techinna, otce města Náchas. Ti jsou muži Rechy.
t: Eston begot Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinna, father of the city of Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

o: Synové pak Cenezovi: Otoniel a Saraiáš. Synové pak Otonielovi: Chatat.
t: And the sons of Kenaz: Otoniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Otoniel: Hathath.

o: Meonatai pak zplodil Ofru, Saraiáš pak zplodil Joába, otce bydlících v údolí řemeslníků; nebo tam řemeslníci byli.
t: Meonathai begot Ophrah; and Sharaiah begot Joab, father of the dwellings of the craftsmen; for the craftsmen were there.

o: Synové pak Kálefa, syna Jefonova: Iru, Ela a Naam. Syn pak Ela: Cenez.
t: And the sons of Caleb, son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. And a son of Elah: Kenaz.

o: Synové pak Jehalleleelovi: Zif, Zifa, Tiriáš a Asarel.
t: And the sons of Jehaleleel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiriah, and Asarel.

o: A synové Ezry: Jeter, Mered, Efer a Jalon. Porodila také Miriama, Sammai a Jezba otce Estemo.
t: And the sons of Ezra: Jether, Meredith, Eper, and Jalon. Also Miriam bore Shammai and Jizbah, father of Eshtemoa.

o: Manželka pak jeho Jehudia porodila Jereda otce Gedor, a Hebera otce Socho, a Jekutiele otce Zanoe. A ti jsou synové Betie dcery Faraonovy, kterouž pojal Mered.
t: And his wife Jehudiah bore Jered, father of Gedor, and Heber, father of Socoh, and Jekuthiel, father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah, daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

o: Synové pak manželky Hodia sestry Nachamovy, otce Cejly: Garmi a Estemo Maachatský.
t: And the sons of Hodiah, sister of Naham: Garmai and Estemai the Maachathite.

o: Synové pak Simonovi: Amnon, Rinna, Benchanan a Tilon. A synové Jesi: Zochet a Benzochet.
t: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinna, Benhanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Jesi: Zocheth and Benzoeth.

o: Synové Séla syna Judova: Her otec Lechův, a Lada otec Maresův, a čeledi domu těch, jenž dělali díla kmentová v domě Asbea,
t: The sons of Shelah, son of Judah: Er, father of Lecah, and Ladan, father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked the linenworks at the house of Ashbea,

o: A Jokim a muži Chozeby, Joas a Saraf, kteříž panovali v Moáb, a Jasubi Lechem. Ale ty věci jsou starodávní.
t: And Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Seraf, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi Lechem. Now these things are ancient.

o: Toť jsou ti hrnčíři obyvatelé v štěpnicích a ohradách u krále, příčinou díla jeho tam bydlíce.
t: These are the potters who dwelt in the warrens and hedges by the king, because they lived there by his work.

o: Synové Simeonovi: Namuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zára a Saul.
t: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Saul.

o: Sallum syn jeho, Mabsam syn jeho, Masma syn jeho.
t: Shallum his son, Mabsam his son, Masma his son.

o: Synové pak Masmovi: Hamuel syn jeho, Zakur syn jeho, Semei syn jeho.
t: And the sons of Masma: Hamuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

o: Ten Semei měl synů šestnácte a dcer šest. Bratří pak jejich neměli mnoho synů, tak že vší rodiny jejich nebylo tak mnoho, jako synů Judových.
t: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters. And their brothers did not have many sons, so that the whole family was not so numerous as the sons of Judah.

o: Bydlili pak v Bersabé a Molada a v Azarsual,
t: They dwelt in Beer-sheba and Moladah and in Azarsual,

o: A v Bála, v Esem a v Tolad,
t: And at Balah, at Esem, and at Tolad,

o: A v Betueli, v Horma a v Sicelechu,
t: And at Bethuel, at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

o: A v Betmarchabot, a v Azarsusim, v Betberi a v Saraim. Ta byla města jejich, dokudž kraloval David.
t: And in Beth-marchaboth, and in Azarsusim, and in Beth-beri, and in Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.

o: Vsi také jejich při Etam, Ain, Remmon, Tochen, Asan, pěti městech.
t: And also their villages, at Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Asan, five cities.

o: A tak všecky vesnice jejich, kteréž byly vůkol těch měst až do Baal, ta byla obydlé jejich vedlé rodu jejich.
t: And all their villages round about these cities, as far as Baal, were their habitations, alongside their clan.

o: A Mesobab, Jamlech a Josa syn Amazův;
t: And Meshobab, Jamlech, and Josa the son of Amaz;

o: A Joel, a Jéhu syn Jozabiáše, syna Saraiášova, syna Azielova;
t: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josabiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Aziel;

o: A Elioenai, Jákoba, Jesochaiáš, Asaiáš, Adiel a Jesimeel a Benaiáš;
t: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

o: A Ziza syn Sifi, syna Allonova, syna Jedaiášova, syna Simri, syna Semaiášova.
t: And Ziza the son of Shaph, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiash, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.

o: Tito ze jména vyčtení ustaveni jsou za knížata v čeledech svých, a čeledi otcovské jejich rozmnožily se náramně.
t: These men, named and numbered, are the chiefs of their families, and their father's households have multiplied greatly.

o: A protož brali se, kudyž se vchází k Gedor, až k východu po údolí tom, aby hledali pastev dobytku svému.
t: And so they went out to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

o: I nalezli pastvu hojnou a výbornou, zemi pak prostrannou, bezpečnou a pokojnou, a že z Chama byli ti, kteříž bydlili tam před tím.
t: And they found rich and good pasture, and a broad, secure and peaceful land; and Ham had been the one who dwelt there before them.

o: Protož přišedše ti napsaní ze jména ve dnech Ezechiáše krále Judského, pobořili stany jejich a příbytky, kteříž tam nalezeni byli, a zmordovali je, tak že jich do tohoto dne není, a sami osedli místo nich; nebo měli tu pastvu dobytku svému.
t: And when those who were named came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, they smote their tents and dwellings that were found there, and destroyed them, so that there are none of them to this day; and they settled in their place, for they had pasture for their flocks.

o: Někteří pak z těch synů Simeonových odebrali se na horu Seir, mužů pět set, jichž Pelatia, Neariáš, Refaiáš a Uziel, synové Jesi, byli vůdcové.
t: And some of the sons of Simeon went to Mount Seir, five hundred men, of whom Pelatia, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, sons of Jeshi, were the leaders.

o: I vyplénili ostatek těch, kteříž ušli z Amalechitských, a bydlili tam až do tohoto dne.
t: And they destroyed the remainder of the Amalekites who escaped, and dwelt there until this day.

o: Synové pak Rubenovi prvorozeného Izraelova: (nebo on byl prvorozený, ale když poškvrnil lože otce svého, dáno jest prvorozenství jeho synům Jozefovým, syna Izraelova, však jemu není přičteno prvorozenství.
t: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: (for he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, to the son of Israel; nevertheless the birthright is not counted to him.

o: Nebo Judas byl nejsilnější z bratří svých, a kníže mezi nimi, ale prvorozenství Jozefovi náleželo).
t: For Judah was the strongest of his brothers, and a prince among them; but the birthright belonged to Joseph).

o: Synové, pravím, Rubenovi, prvorozeného Izraelova: Enoch, Fallu, Ezron a Charmi.
t: The sons, I say, of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Enoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Charmi.

o: Synové Joelovi: Semaiáš syn jeho, Gog syn jeho, Semei syn jeho;
t: And the sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son;

o: Mícha syn jeho, Reaiáš syn jeho, Bál syn jeho;
t: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son;

o: Béra syn jeho, jehož zavedl Tiglatfalazar král Assyrský. Ten byl knížetem pokolení Rubenova.
t: Bera his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took away. He was a prince of the family of Reuben.

o: Bratří pak jeho po čeledech jejich, když vyčteni byli po rodinách svých, knížetem byl Jehiel a Zachariáš.
t: His brothers dwelt with their families in their dwellings, when they were counted by their families, Jehiel and Zechariah were princes.

o: A Béla syn Azaza, syna Semy, syna Joelova. Ten bydlil v Aroer až do Nébo a Balmeon.
t: And Bela son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel. He dwelt in Aroer unto Nebo and Baal-meon.

o: Potom i na východ bydlil, až kudy se vchází na poušť od řeky Eufrates; nebo stáda jejich rozmnožila se v zemi Galádské.
t: Then he dwelt on the east, unto the entrance into the desert from the river Euphrates; for their flocks multiplied in the land of Gilead.

o: Pročež ve dnech Saulových bojovali s Agarenskými, kteříž poraženi jsou od ruky jejich. A tak bydlili v staních jejich po vší krajině východní země Galádské.
t: For in the days of Saul they fought against the Hagrites, who were overcome by their hand. And they dwelt in their tents in all the eastern region of Gilead.

o: Synové pak Gádovi naproti nim bydlili v zemi Bázan, až do Sálechy.
t: And the sons of Gad dwelt over against them in the land of Bashan unto Salecah.

o: Joel byl kníže jejich, a Safan druhý. Ale Janai a Safat v Bázan zůstali.
t: Joel was their prince, and Shaphan the second. But Janai and Shaphat dwelt in Bashan.

o: Bratří pak jejich po domích otců svých: Michael, Mesullam, Seba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia, Heber, těch sedm.
t: Now their brothers after their fathers' houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorah, Jachan, Zia, Heber, seven in all.

o: (Ti byli synové Abichailovi, synové Hurovi, synové Jaroachovi, synové Galádovi, synové Michaelovi, synové Jesisovi, synové Jachdovi, synové Buzovi.)
t: (These were the sons of Abihail, the sons of Huri, the sons of Jaroah, the sons of Gilead, the sons of Michael, the sons of Jeshishai, the sons of Jachdani, the sons of Buz.)

o: Též Ahi syn Abdiele, syna Gunova, kníže v domě otců jich.
t: Also Ahijah, the son of Abiel, the son of GUN, a prince in the house of their fathers.

o: I bydlili v Galád, v Bázan a v vesnicech jeho, a ve všech předměstích Sáron, až do hranic jejich.
t: And they dwelt in Gilead, in Bashan, and in the villages thereof, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, unto their border.

o: Všickni tito vyčteni byli ve dnech Jotama krále Judského, a ve dnech Jeroboáma krále Izraelského.
t: All these were counted in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

o: Synů Rubenových a Gádových a polovice pokolení Manassesova, mužů silných, nosících štít a meč, a natahujících lučiště, a umělých v bitvě, čtyřidceti a čtyři tisíce, sedm set a šedesát vycházejících k boji.
t: The sons of Reuben and Gad and half the tribe of Manasseh, men of valor, bearing shields and swords, and drawing bows, and skilled in battle, forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty going out to battle.

o: I bojovali s Agarenskými, Iturejskými, Nafejskými a Nodabskými.
t: And they fought against the Hagrites, the Itureans, the Naphishites, and the Nodabites.

o: A měli pomoc proti nim. I dáni jsou v ruku jich Agarenové i všecko, což měli. Nebo k Bohu volali v boji, a vyslyšel je, nebo doufali v něho.
t: And they had help against them. And the Hagrites and all their spoil were given into their hand; for they called upon God in battle, and he heard them, for they trusted in him.

o: I zajali stáda jejich, velbloudů jejich padesáte tisíců, a dobytka dvě stě a padesáte tisíců, a oslů dva tisíce, a lidí sto tisíc osob.
t: And they took away their flocks, fifty thousand camels, and two hundred and fifty thousand cattle, and two thousand asses, and one hundred thousand men.

o: Zraněných také množství padlo, nebo od Boha byla porážka ta. I bydlili na místě jejich až do přestěhování svého.
t: For a multitude also fell wounded; for the battle was of God. And they dwelt in their place until the carrying away of themselves.

o: Synové pak polovice pokolení Manassesova bydlili v té zemi od Bázanu až do Balhermon i Sanir, totiž hory Hermon; nebo i oni rozmnoženi byli.
t: And the sons of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in that land from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Sanir, that is, the mount of Hermon; for they also multiplied.

o: Tato pak byla knížata v domě otců jejich: Efer, Jesi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiáš, Hodaviáš a Jachdiel, muži udatní a silní, muži slovoutní, knížata domu otců svých.
t: And these were the princes in the house of their fathers: Ephraim, Jeshishai, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jachdiel, men of valor and mighty men, men of renown, princes of the house of their fathers.

o: Ale když přestoupili proti Bohu otců svých, a smilnili, následujíce bohů národů země té, kteréž shladil Bůh od tváři jejich:
t: But when they trespassed against the God of their fathers, and consented to the gods of the nations of that land, whom God had destroyed from before their face:

o: Vzbudil Bůh Izraelský ducha Fule krále Assyrského, a ducha Tiglatfalazara krále Assyrského, kterýž přenesl pokolení Rubenovo a Gádovo a polovici pokolení Manassesova, a dovedl je do Chelach a do Chabor, až do Hara a k řece Gozan až do dnešního dne.
t: God stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, who carried away the family of Reuben and Gad, and the half family of Manasseh, and brought them unto Chelah and unto Chabor, unto Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

o: Synové Léví: Gerson, Kahat a Merari.
t: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

o: Synové pak Kahat: Amram, Izar, Hebron a Uziel.
t: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

o: Synové pak Amramovi: Aron, Mojžíš, a Maria. Synové pak Aronovi: Nádab, Abiu, Eleazar a Itamar.
t: The sons of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

o: Eleazar zplodil Fínesa, Fínes zplodil Abisua.
t: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua.

o: Abisua pak zplodil Bukki, Bukki pak zplodil Uzi.
t: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi.

o: Uzi pak zplodil Zerachiáše, Zerachiáš pak zplodil Meraiota.
t: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth.

o: Meraiot zplodil Amariáše, Amariáš pak zplodil Achitoba.
t: And Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub.

o: Achitob pak zplodil Sádocha, Sádoch pak zplodil Achimaasa.
t: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaas.

o: Achimaas pak zplodil Azariáše, Azariáš pak zplodil Jochanana.
t: And Ahimaas begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan.

o: Jochanan pak zplodil Azariáše. Onť jest užíval kněžství v domě, jejž ustavěl Šalomoun v Jeruzalémě.
t: And Johanan begat Azariah. He used the priest office in the house which Solomon built in Jerusalem.

o: Zplodil pak Azariáš Amariáše, Amariáš pak zplodil Achitoba.
t: Then Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub.

o: Achitob zplodil Sádocha, Sádoch pak zplodil Salluma.
t: Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum.

o: Sallum pak zplodil Helkiáše, Helkiáš pak zplodil Azariáše.
t: Shallum begat Helkiah, and Helkiah begat Azariah.

o: Azariáš pak zplodil Saraiáše, Saraiáš pak zplodil Jozadaka.
t: Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begate Jehozadak.

o: Jozadak pak odšel, když převedl Hospodin Judu a Jeruzalém skrze Nabuchodonozora.
t: Jehozadak went away when the Lord had exiled Judah and Jerusalem through Nebuchadnezzar.

o: Synové Léví: Gersom, Kahat a Merari.
t: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

o: Tato pak jsou jména synů Gersomových: Lebni a Semei.
t: Now these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

o: Synové pak Kahat: Amram, Izar, Hebron a Uziel.
t: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

o: Synové Merari: Moholi a Musi. A tak ty jsou čeledi Levítů po otcích jejich.
t: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

o: Gersomovi: Lebni syn jeho, Jachat syn jeho, Zimma syn jeho,
t: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimnah his son,

o: Joach syn jeho, Iddo syn jeho, Zára syn jeho, Jetrai syn jeho.
t: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son, Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

o: Synové Kahat: Aminadab syn jeho, Chóre syn jeho, Assir syn jeho,
t: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Kore his son, Assir his son,

o: Elkána syn jeho, a Abiazaf syn jeho, Assir syn jeho,
t: Elkanah his son, and Abiasaph his son, Assir his son,

o: Tachat syn jeho, Uriel syn jeho, Uziáš syn jeho, Saul syn jeho.
t: Tachah his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, Saul his son.

o: Synové pak Elkánovi: Amasai a Achimot.
t: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

o: Elkána: Synové Elkánovi: Zofai syn jeho, a Nachat syn jeho,
t: Elkanah: The sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

o: Eliab syn jeho, Jerocham syn jeho, Elkána syn jeho.
t: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

o: Synové pak Samuelovi: Prvorozený Vasni a Abia.
t: The sons of Samuel: his firstborn Vasni and Abiah.

o: Synové Merari: Moholi, Lebni syn jeho, Semei syn jeho, Uza syn jeho,
t: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

o: Sima syn jeho, Aggia syn jeho, Azaiáš syn jeho.
t: Shimea his son, Aggiah his son, Azariah his son.

o: Tito jsou pak, kteréž ustanovil David k zpívání v domě Hospodinově, když tam postavena truhla,
t: Now these are those whom David appointed to sing in the house of the Lord, when the ark was set up,

o: Kteříž přisluhovali před příbytkem stánku úmluvy zpíváním, dokudž neustavěl Šalomoun domu Hospodinova v Jeruzalémě, a stáli podlé pořádku svého v přisluhování svém.
t: who served before the tent of the testimony with singing, until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they stood in their appointed order in their service.

o: Tito jsou pak, kteříž stáli, i synové jejich, z synů Kahat: Héman kantor, syn Joele, syna Samuelova,
t: Now these are those who stood, with their sons, of the sons of Kohath: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

o: Syna Elkánova, syna Jerochamova, syna Elielova, syna Tohu,
t: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Tohu,

o: Syna Sufova, syna Elkánova, syna Machatova, syna Amasai,
t: The son of Shaph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

o: Syna Elkánova, syna Joelova, syna Azariášova, syna Sofoniášova,
t: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zophoniah,

o: Syna Tachatova, syna Assirova, syna Abiazafova, syna Chóre,
t: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Abiasaph, the son of Kore,

o: Syna Izarova, syna Kahatova, syna Léví, syna Izraelova.
t: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

o: A bratr jeho Azaf, kterýž stával po pravici jeho. Azaf pak byl syn Berechiáše, syna Simova,
t: and his brother Azaph, who stood on his right hand. Now Azaph was the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimei,

o: Syna Michaelova, syna Baaseiášova, syna Malkiášova,
t: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

o: Syna Etni, syna Záry, syna Adaiova,
t: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

o: Syna Etanova, syna Zimmova, syna Semeiova,
t: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimnah, the son of Shimei,

o: Syna Jachatova, syna Gersomova, syna Léví.
t: The sons of Jashub, the sons of Gershom, the sons of Levi.

o: Synové pak Merari, bratří jejich, stávali po levici: Etan, syn Kísi, syna Abdova, syna Malluchova,
t: Now the sons of Merari, their brothers, stood on the left hand: Ethan, the son of Kish, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

o: Syna Chasabiášova, syna Amaziášova, syna Helkiášova,
t: The sons of Hashabiah, the sons of Amaziah, the sons of Hilkiah,

o: Syna Amzova, syna Bánova, syna Semerova,
t: The sons of Amzi, the sons of Bani, the sons of Shemer,

o: Syna Moholi, syna Musi, syna Merari, syna Léví.
t: The sons of Mahli, the sons of Mushi, the sons of Merari, the sons of Levi.

o: Bratří pak jejich Levítové jiní oddáni jsou ke všelikému přisluhování příbytku domu Božího.
t: Now their brothers the Levites, the others, were appointed to all the service of the tent of the house of God.

o: Ale Aron a synové jeho pálili na oltáři zápalu a na oltáři kadění, při všelikém přisluhování svatyně svatých, a k očišťování Izraele podlé všeho toho, jakož přikázal Mojžíš služebník Boží.
t: But Aaron and his sons offered burnt offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense, in all the service of the most holy place, and for the cleansing of Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

o: Tito pak jsou synové Aronovi: Eleazar syn jeho, Fínes syn jeho, Abisua syn jeho,
t: Now these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

o: Bukki syn jeho, Uzi syn jeho, Zerachiáš syn jeho,
t: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

o: Meraiot syn jeho, Amariáš syn jeho, Achitob syn jeho,
t: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

o: Sádoch syn jeho, Achimaas syn jeho.
t: Zadok his son, Ahimaas his son.

o: A tato obydlé jejich, po příbytcích jejich, v mezech jejich, synů Aronových po čeledi Kahatských; nebo jejich byl los.
t: Now these are their dwelling places, in their tents, in their borders, of the sons of Aaron, of the family of the Kohathites; for theirs was the lot.

o: A protož dali jim Hebron v zemi Judské, a předměstí jeho vůkol něho.
t: And so they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and its suburbs round about it.

o: Pole však městská a vsi jejich dali Kálefovi synu Jefonovu.
t: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

o: Synům pak Aronovým dali z měst Judských města útočišťná: Hebron a Lebno a předměstí jeho, a Jeter i Estemo a předměstí jeho,
t: Now to the sons of Aaron they gave from the cities of Judah cities of refuge: Hebron and Libnah and its suburbs, and Jethro and Eshtemoa and its suburbs,

o: A Holon i předměstí jeho, a Dabir i předměstí jeho,
t: Hilen, Debir,

o: Též Asan a předměstí jeho, a Betsemes a předměstí jeho.
t: Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.

o: Z pokolení pak Beniamin: Gaba a předměstí jeho, a Allemet i předměstí jeho, i Anatot a předměstí jeho, všech měst jejich třinácte měst po čeledech jejich.
t: And of the tribe of Benjamin: Gibeon and its villages, and Alemeth and its villages, and Anathoth and its villages, all their cities, thirteen cities, according to their families.

o: Synům též Kahatovým ostatním z čeledi toho pokolení dáno v polovici pokolení Manassesova losem měst deset.
t: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath, of that tribe, were given by lot ten cities out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.

o: Synům pak Gersonovým po čeledech jejich v pokolení Izachar a v pokolení Asser, a v pokolení Neftalím, a v pokolení Manassesovu v Bázan měst třináct.
t: Now to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, in the tribe of Issachar, and in the tribe of Asher, and in the tribe of Naphtali, and in the tribe of Manasseh, in Bashan, thirteen cities.

o: Synům Merari po čeledech jejich v pokolení Ruben, a v pokolení Gád, a v pokolení Zabulon losem měst dvanáct.
t: To the sons of Merari, according to their families, in the tribe of Reuben, and in the tribe of Gad, and in the tribe of Zebulun, were given by lot twelve cities.

o: Dali synové Izraelští Levítům ta města a předměstí jejich.
t: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities and their suburbs.

o: A dali je losem v pokolení synů Judových, a v pokolení synů Simeonových, a v pokolení synů Beniaminových, města ta, kteráž jmenovali ze jména.
t: And they gave them by lot in the tribe of the sons of Judah, and in the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and in the tribe of the sons of Benjamin, those cities which they named by name.

o: A kteříž byli z čeledi synů Kahat, (byla pak města a hranice jejich v pokolení Efraimovu),
t: And some of the family of the sons of Kohath (the cities and their borders were in the tribe of Ephraim),

o: Těm dali města útočišťná: Sichem a předměstí jeho na hoře Efraim, a Gázer a předměstí jeho,
t: they gave them cities of refuge: Shechem and its suburbs on Mount Ephraim, and Gezer and its suburbs,

o: A Jekmaam i předměstí jeho, a Betoron i předměstí jeho,
t: Jokmeam, Beth-horon,

o: Též i Aialon a předměstí jeho, a Getremmon s předměstím jeho.
t: And also Aijalon and its villages, and Gath-rimmon and its villages.

o: A v polovici pokolení Manassesova: Aner a předměstí jeho, Balám a předměstí jeho, čeledem synů Kahat ostatním.
t: And in the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its villages, and Balam and its villages, to the rest of the families of the sons of Kohath.

o: Synům pak Gersonovým v čeledi polovice pokolení Manassesova dali Golan v Bázan s předměstím jeho, a Astarot i předměstí jeho.
t: To the sons of Gershon, of the family of half the tribe of Manasseh, they gave Golan in Bashan with its villages, and Ashtaroth with its villages.

o: V pokolení pak Izachar: Kádes s předměstím jeho, Daberet a předměstí jeho,
t: And of the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its villages, Dabereth and its villages,

o: Rámot také s předměstím jeho, a Anem i předměstí jeho.
t: And Ramoth and its villages, and Anem and its villages.

o: V pokolení pak Asser: Masal s předměstím jeho, a Abdon i předměstí jeho,
t: And of the tribe of Asher: Masal and its villages, and Abdon and its villages,

o: Též Hukok s předměstím jeho, Rohob také i předměstí jeho.
t: And also Hukok and its villages, and Rehob and its villages.

o: V pokolení pak Neftalímovu: Kádes v Galilei a předměstí jeho, Hamon a předměstí jeho, a Kariataim i předměstí jeho.
t: And of the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its villages, Hamon and its villages, and Kerioth and its villages.

o: Synům Merari ostatním v pokolení Zabulonovu dali Remmon s předměstím jeho, Tábor a předměstí jeho.
t: To the rest of the sons of Merari, of the tribe of Zebulun, they gave Remmon with its villages, Tabor with its villages.

o: A za Jordánem u Jericha, k východní straně Jordánu, v pokolení Rubenovu: Bozor na poušti s předměstím jeho, a Jasa i předměstí jeho.
t: And beyond Jordan, by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, in the tribe of Reuben: Bozrah in the wilderness and its villages, and Jaaz and its villages.

o: Kedemot také s předměstím jeho, a Mefat i předměstí jeho.
t: And Kedemoth and its villages, and Mephaath and its villages.

o: V pokolení pak Gád: Rámot v Galád s předměstím jeho, a Mahanaim i předměstí jeho,
t: And of the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its villages, and Mahanaim and its villages,

o: I Ezebon s předměstím jeho, a Jazer i předměstí jeho.
t: And Ezekon and its villages, and Jazer and its villages.

o: Synové pak Izacharovi: Tola, Fua, Jasub a Simron, čtyři.
t: Now the sons of Issachar: Tola, Pua, Jashub and Shimron, four.

o: Synové pak Tolovi: Uzi, Refaia, Jeriel, Jachmai, Jipsam, Samuel, knížata po domích otců jejich, pošlí od Toly, muži udatní v pokoleních svých. Počet jejich ve dnech Davidových byl dvamecítma tisíců a šest set.
t: Now the sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jashmai, I sham, Samuel, princes of their fathers' houses, sent by Tola, mighty men in their tribes. Their number by David's days was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

o: Synové Uzovi: Izrachiáš. Synové pak Izrachiášovi: Michael, Abdiáš, Joel a Isia, všech pět knížat.
t: The sons of Uzzi: Izriah. And the sons of Izriah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Isiah, five princes.

o: A s nimi v pokoleních jejich, po čeledech jejich otcovských, mužů válečných třidceti šest tisíců; nebo mnoho měli žen a synů.
t: And with them, in their tribes, according to their fathers' families, men of war thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

o: Bratří také jejich po všech čeledech Izachar, mužů udatných osmdesáte sedm tisíců, všech vyčtených.
t: And their brothers throughout all the families of Issachar, mighty men eighty-seven thousand, all numbered.

o: Synové Beniaminovi: Béla, Becher, Jediael, tři.
t: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher and Jediael, three.

o: Synové pak Bélovi: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Jerimot a Iri, pět knížat čeledí otcovských, muži udatní; načteno jich dvamecítma tisíců, třidceti a čtyři.
t: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uziel, Jerimoth and Iri, five princes of the families of their fathers, mighty men of valor; and there were enrolled of them twenty-two thousand and thirty-four.

o: Potom synové Becherovi: Zemira, Joas, Eliezer, Elioenai, Amri, Jeremot, Abiáš, Anatot a Alemet, všickni synové Becherovi.
t: Then the sons of Becher: Zemiram, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Amri, Jeremoth, Abishah, Anathoth, and Alemeth, all the sons of Becher.

o: Kterýchž počet po pokoleních jejich, a po knížatech v domě čeledí otcovských, mužů udatných, dvadceti tisíců a dvě stě.
t: And the number of them according to their generations, and according to the rulers of the house of their fathers, of valiant men, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

o: Synové také Jediaelovi: Bilan. Synové pak Bilanovi: Jeus, Beniamin, Ahod, Kenan, Zetan, Tarsis a Achisachar.
t: The sons of Jediael also: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ahod, Kenan, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishachar.

o: Všech těch synů Jediaelových po knížatech čeledí, mužů udatných, sedmnáct tisíc a dvě stě, vycházejících na vojnu k bitvě,
t: All these sons of Jediael according to the rulers of the house, valiant men, seventeen thousand and two hundred, who went out to war and to battle.

o: Kromě Suppim a Chuppim, synů doma zrozených, a Chusim, synů vně zplozených.
t: Besides Suppim and Huppim, the sons of those born in the house, and Chushim, the sons of those begotten outside.

o: Synové Neftalímovi: Jasiel, Guni, Jezer a Sallum, synové Bály.
t: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Gunni, Jezer, and Shillem, the sons of Bilhah.

o: Synové Manassesovi: Asriel, kteréhož mu manželka porodila. (Ženina též jeho Syrská porodila Machira, otce Galád.
t: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his wife bore. Also his Syrian wife bore Machir, the father of Gilead.

o: Machir pak vzal manželku Chuppimovu a Suppimovu, a jméno sestry jeho Maacha.) Jméno pak druhého Salfad, a měl Salfad dcery.
t: Machir took to wife the daughter of Hoppim and Shuppim, and the name of his sister was Maacah. And the name of his second son was Shaphath, and Shaphath had daughters.

o: Porodila pak Maacha manželka Machirova syna, kteréhož nazvala Fáres, a jméno bratra jeho Sáres, synové pak jeho Ulam a Rekem.
t: And Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, whom she named Phares, and the name of his brother was Shereh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.

o: Synové pak Ulamovi: Bedan. Tiť jsou synové Galád syna Machirova, syna Manassesova.
t: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These are the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

o: Sestra pak jeho Molechet porodila Ishoda a Abiezera a Machla.
t: And his sister Molocheth bore Ishod and Abiezer and Mahlah.

o: Byli pak synové Semidovi: Achian, Sechem, Likchi a Aniam.
t: And the sons of Shemida: Ahian, Shem, Llich, and Aniam.

o: Synové pak Efraimovi: Sutelach, a Bered syn jeho, Tachat syn jeho, Elada syn jeho, Tachat syn jeho,
t: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, Tachath his son, Eladah his son, Tachath his son,

o: Též Zabad syn jeho, Sutelach syn jeho, Ezer a Elad. I zbili je muži Gát, kteříž zrozeni byli v zemi té; nebo sstoupili byli, aby zajali dobytky jejich.
t: Also Zabed his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer and Elad. And the men of Gath slew them, who were born in that land; for they had come down to take away their cattle.

o: Protož kvílil Efraim otec jejich za mnohé dny, a přišli bratří jeho, aby ho těšili.
t: Wherefore Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

o: Potom všel k manželce své, kteráž počala a porodila syna, a nazval jméno jeho Beria, že byl v zámutku pro rodinu svou.
t: Then he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Beriah, because he was in distress for his family.

o: Dceru také Seeru, kteráž vystavěla Betoron dolní i horní, a Uzen Seera.
t: And a daughter, Sheerah, who built Beth-horon the lower and the upper, and Uzen-sheerah.

o: A Refacha syna jeho, Resefa, Telecha, a Tachana syna jeho,
t: And Refah his son, Resheph, Telah, and Tahanah his son,

o: Ladana syna jeho, Amiuda syna jeho, Elisama syna jeho,
t: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

o: Non syna jeho, Jozue syna jeho.
t: Non his son, Joshua his son.

o: Vládařství pak jejich a bydlení jejich Bethel s vesnicemi svými, a k východu Náran, a k západu Gázer a vesnice jeho, Sichem s vesnicemi svými, až do Gázy a vesnic jeho.
t: Now their possessions and dwellings were Bethel and its villages, and to the east Naarash, and to the west Gezer and its villages, Shechem and its villages, even to Gaza and its villages.

o: A v místech naproti synům Manassesovým: Betsan s vesnicemi svými, Tanach s vesnicemi svými, Mageddo s vesnicemi svými, Dor s vesnicemi svými. V těch bydlili synové Jozefa syna Izraelova.
t: And in the places opposite the sons of Manasseh: Beth-shan with its villages, Taanach with its villages, Megiddo with its villages, Dor with its villages. In these dwelt the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel.

o: Synové Asser: Jemna, Jesua, Jesui, Beria, a Serach sestra jejich.
t: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Jeshua, Jesui, Beria, and Serah their sister.

o: Synové pak Beriovi: Heber, Melchiel. Onť jest otec Birzavitův.
t: Now the sons of Beriah: Heber, and Maniel. He is the father of the Birsites.

o: Heber pak zplodil Jafleta, Somera, Chotama, a Suu sestru jejich.
t: And Heber begat Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Suah their sister.

o: Synové pak Jafletovi: Pasach, Bimhal, a Asvat. Ti jsou synové Jafletovi.
t: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Asvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.

o: Synové pak Somerovi: Achi, Rohaga, Jehubba a Aram.
t: And the sons of Shomer: Ahikam, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

o: Synové pak Helema, bratra jeho: Zofach, Jimna, Seles a Amal.
t: And the sons of Helem, his brother: Zopham, Jimna, Sheles, and Amal.

o: Synové Zofachovi: Suach, Charnefer, Sual, Beri a Jimra,
t: The sons of Zopham: Suah, Charneph, Shual, Beri, and Jimram,

o: Bezer, Hod, Samma, Silsa, Jitran a Béra.
t: Bezer, Hod, Shammah, Shilsa, Jitran, and Beerah.

o: Synové Jeterovi: Jefunne, Fispa a Ara.
t: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

o: Synové pak Ulla: Arach, Haniel a Riziáš.
t: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, Haniel, and Riziah.

o: Všickni ti synové Asser, knížata domů otcovských, vybraní, udatní, přední z knížat, kteříž vyčteni do vojska k bitvě, v počtu šest a dvadceti tisíc mužů.
t: All these are the sons of Asher, princes of their fathers' houses, choice, mighty, leading of the princes, who were numbered for war, to the number of twenty-six thousand men.

o: Beniamin pak zplodil Bélu, prvorozeného svého, Asbele druhého, Achracha třetího,
t: And Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

o: Nocha čtvrtého, Rafa pátého.
t: Nogah the fourth, Raphah the fifth.

o: Béla pak měl syny: Addara, Geru, Abiuda,
t: And Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, and Abihud,

o: Abisua, Námana, Achoacha,
t: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

o: A Geru, Sefufana a Churama.
t: And Gerash, Shephuphan, and Huram.

o: Ti jsou synové Echudovi, ti jsou knížata čeledí otcovských, bydlících v Gabaa, kteříž je uvedli do Manáhat,
t: These are the sons of Ehud, they are princes of their fathers' families, dwelling in Gibeah, who brought them up to Manahath,

o: Totiž: Náman, a Achia a Gera. On přestěhoval je; zplodil pak Uza a Achichuda.
t: Namely, Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera. He removed them; and he begat Uza and Ahihud.

o: Sacharaim pak zplodil v krajině Moábské, když onen byl propustil je, s Chusimou a Bárou manželkami svými.
t: And Sharaim begat in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away, with his wives Hushim and Bera.

o: Zplodil s Chodes manželkou svou Jobaba, Sebia, Mésa a Malkama,
t: And Hodes begat with Chodes his wife Jobab, Sebia, Mesa, and Malcam,

o: Jehuza, Sachia a Mirma. Ti jsou synové jeho, knížata čeledí otcovských.
t: Jehuzah, Sachiah, and Mirma. These are his sons, princes of the fathers' households.

o: S Chusimou pak byl zplodil Abitoba a Elpále.
t: And with his wife Chushim he begat Abitub and Elpal.

o: Synové pak Elpálovi: Heber, Misam a Semer. Ten vystavěl Ono a Lod, i vsi jeho.
t: And the sons of Elpal were Heber, Misham, and Shemer. He built Ono and Lod, with all its villages.

o: A Beria a Sema. Ti jsou knížata čeledí otcovských, bydlících v Aialon; ti zahnali obyvatele Gát.
t: And Beria and Shema. These are princes of the fathers' households, dwelling in Aijon; they drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

o: Achio pak, Sasák a Jeremot,
t: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

o: Zebadiáš, Arad a Ader,
t: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

o: Michael, Ispa a Jocha synové Beria.
t: Michael, Ishpah, and Joah the sons of Beria.

o: A Zebadiáš, Mesullam, Chiski, Heber,
t: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

o: Ismerai, Izliáš a Jobab synové Elpálovi.
t: Ismerai, Izliah, and Jobab the sons of Eliphelet.

o: A Jakim, Zichri a Zabdi.
t: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

o: Elienai, Ziletai a Eliel,
t: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

o: Adaiáš, Baraiáš a Simrat synové Simei.
t: Adaiah, Bariah, and Shemrah the sons of Shimei.

o: Ispan a Heber a Eliel,
t: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

o: Abdon, Zichri a Chanan,
t: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

o: Chananiáš, Elam a Anatotiáš,
t: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

o: Ifdaiáš a Fanuel synové Sasákovi.
t: Iphdiah and Fanuel the sons of Shashak.

o: Samserai, Sechariáš a Ataliáš,
t: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

o: Jaresiáš, Eliáš a Zichri synové Jerochamovi.
t: Jaresiah, Elijah, and Zichri, sons of Jeroham.

o: Ta jsou knížata otcovských čeledí po rodinách svých, kterážto knížata bydlila v Jeruzalémě.
t: These are princes of the fathers' households according to their families, these princes who dwelt in Jerusalem.

o: V Gabaon pak bydlilo kníže Gabaon, a jméno manželky jeho Maacha.
t: And the prince of Gibeon dwelt in Gibeon, and the name of his wife was Maacah.

o: A syn jeho prvorozený Abdon, Zur, Cis, Bál a Nádab,
t: And his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Cis, Baal, and Nadab,

o: Ale Gedor, Achio, Zecher.
t: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

o: A Miklot zplodil Simea. I ti také naproti bratřím svým bydlili v Jeruzalémě s bratřími svými.
t: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt in Jerusalem with their brethren.

o: Ner pak zplodil Cisa, a Cis zplodil Saule. Saul pak zplodil Jonatu, Melchisua, Abinadaba a Ezbále.
t: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, Melchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

o: Syn pak Jonatův Meribbál, Meribbál pak zplodil Mícha.
t: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.

o: Synové pak Míchovi: Piton, Melech, Tarea a Achaz.
t: And the sons of Micah: Pthon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

o: Achaz pak zplodil Jehoadu, Jehoada pak zplodil Alemeta, Azmaveta a Zimru. Zimri pak zplodil Mozu.
t: And Ahaz begat Jehoaddan; and Jehoaddan begat Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza.

o: Moza pak zplodil Bina. Ráfa syn jeho, Elasa syn jeho, Azel syn jeho.
t: And Moza begat Bena; and Raah his son, Eleash his son, and Azel his son.

o: Azel pak měl šest synů, jichž tato jsou jména: Azrikam, Bochru, Izmael, Seariáš a Abdiáš a Chanan. Všickni ti synové Azelovi.
t: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bochor, Ishmael, Sheariah, Abdiash, and Chanan. All these are the sons of Azel.

o: Synové pak Ezeka, bratra jeho: Ulam prvorozený jeho, Jehus druhý, a Elifelet třetí.
t: And the sons of Ezekah, his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.

o: A byli synové Ulamovi muži udatní a střelci umělí, kteříž měli mnoho synů a vnuků až do sta a padesáti. Všickni ti byli z synů Beniaminových.
t: And the sons of Ulam were valiant men, expert archers, who had many sons and grandsons, to fifty and more. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

o: A tak všickni Izraelští sečteni byli, a aj, zapsáni jsou v knize králů Izraelských a Judských, a přeneseni jsou do Babylona pro přestoupení své.
t: So all Israel were numbered; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, and are carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

o: Ti pak, kteříž bydlili prvé v vládařství svém v městech svých, totiž Izraelští, kněží, Levítové a Netinejští,
t: And those who dwelt first in their dominion in their cities, namely Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim,

o: Bydlili v Jeruzalémě, z synů Judových, z synů Beniaminových, ano i z synů Efraimových a Manassesových:
t: Dwelt in Jerusalem, and of the sons of Judah, and of the sons of Benjamin, and also of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:

o: Uttai syn Amiuda, syna Amri, syna Imri, syna Bani, z synů Fáresových, syna Judova.
t: Uttai the son of Ammiel, the son of Amri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Phares, the son of Judah.

o: A z čeledi Silonovy: Azaiáš prvorozený a synové jeho.
t: And of the family of Shilon: Azariah his firstborn and his sons.

o: A z synů Zerachových: Jehuel, a příbuzných jejich šest set a devadesát.
t: And of the sons of Zerah: Jehuel, and their relatives, six hundred and ninety.

o: Z synů pak Beniaminových: Sallu syn Mesullama, syna Hodavia, syna Hasenuova,
t: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

o: A Ibneiáš syn Jerochamův, Ela syn Uzi, syna Michri, a Mesullam syn Sefatiáše, syna Rehuelova, syna Ibniášova.
t: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, Ela the son of Uzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shaphatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.

o: Bratří také jejich po pokoleních jejich, devět set padesáte a šest; všickni ti muži knížata čeledí po domích otců svých.
t: And their brethren according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six; all these were men of the princes of the households according to the houses of their fathers.

o: Z kněží také Jedaiáš, Jehoiarib a Jachin,
t: And of the priests: Jedaiiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

o: Azariáš syn Helkiáše, syna Mesullamova, syna Sádochova, syna Meraiotova, syna Achitobova, kníže v domě Božím.
t: Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitob, ruler of the house of God.

o: A Adaiáš syn Jerochama, syna Paschurova, syna Malchiášova, a Masai syn Adiele, syna Jachzery, syna Mesullamova, syna Mesillemitova, syna Immerova.
t: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchiah, and Masai the son of Adiel, the son of Jazer, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer.

o: A bratří jejich knížata po domích otců svých, tisíc sedm set a šedesát mužů udatných v práci přisluhování domu Božího.
t: And their brothers, rulers over the houses of their fathers, one thousand seven hundred and sixty men, brave in the service of the house of God.

o: A z Levítů: Semaiáš syn Chasuba, syna Azrikamova, syna Chasabiášova, z synů Merari.
t: And of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hassub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari.

o: A Bakbakar Cheres, a Galal, a Mataniáš syn Míchy, syna Zichri, syna Azafova.
t: And Bakbakkar, Cheres, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Azaph.

o: A Abdiáš syn Semaiáše, syna Galalova, syna Jedutunova, a Berechiáš syn Asy, syna Elkánova, kterýž přebýval ve vsech Netofatských.
t: And Abdiash the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Nethophathites.

o: Též vrátní: Sallum a Akkub, a Talmon, Achiman, i bratří jejich, z nichž byl Sallum kníže.
t: And the gatekeepers: Shallum and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren; and Shallum was the prince.

o: Kterýž až po dnes v bráně královské stával k východu, onino pak vrátnými byli po houfích synů Léví.
t: And even unto this day he stood at the king's gate on the east; and the gatekeepers were over the companies of the sons of Levi.

o: Ale Sallum syn Chóre, syna Abiazafova, syna Chóre, a bratří jeho z domu otce jeho, Chorejští, nad pracemi přisluhování, ostříhali prahů při stánku, tak jako otcové jejich nad vojskem Hospodinovým, kteříž ostříhali vcházení.
t: But Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Abiazaph, the son of Kore, and his brethren of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the works of the service, keeping the thresholds of the tent, as their fathers had kept the entrance.

o: Nad kterýmiž Fínes syn Eleazarův byl někdy knížetem, a Hospodin byl s ním.
t: And over them was Phinehas the son of Eleazar, who was prince; and the Lord was with him.

o: Zachariáš pak syn Meselemiášův vrátným byl u dveří stánku úmluvy.
t: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the tent of the testimony.

o: Všickni ti voleni za vrátné k veřejím, osob dvě stě a dvanáct. Ti ve vsech svých vyčteni jsou, kteréž nařídil David a Samuel vidoucí, pro jejich věrnost,
t: All these chosen to be gatekeepers, two hundred and twelve; and they were enrolled according to their generations, whom David and Samuel the seer had appointed, for their faithfulness,

o: Aby oni i synové jejich byli při branách domu Hospodinova, v domě stánku po strážích.
t: That they and their sons might be at the gates of the house of the Lord, in the tent, serving as watchmen.

o: Po čtyřech stranách byli vrátní, k východu, k západu, k půlnoci a ku poledni.
t: On four sides were the gatekeepers: to the east, to the west, to the north, and to the south.

o: A bratří jejich, po vsech svých bydlící, aby každého sedmého dne časy svými přicházeli s nimi.
t: And their brothers, dwelling in all their quarters, came to them regularly, every seventh day, in their turns.

o: Nebo Levítové byli pod spravou těch čtyř předních vrátných, a byli nad komorami a nad poklady domu Božího,
t: For the Levites were under the oversight of the four chief gatekeepers; and they were over the chambers and over the treasures of the house of God.

o: A aby vůkol domu Božího ponocovali; nebo jim poručena stráž, a otvírati každý den ráno.
t: And they were to surround the house of God round about; for they had the charge of the watch, to open it every morning.

o: Z těch také ustaveni nad nádobami přisluhování; nebo v počtu vnášeli je, a v jistém počtu též vynášeli.
t: Some of them also were appointed over the vessels of service; and they counted them in, and carried them out in a certain number.

o: Z nichž opět někteří postaveni byli nad nádobami jinými a nade všemi nádobami posvátnými, a nad bělí, vínem, olejem, kadidlem a vonnými věcmi.
t: And some of them were appointed over other vessels, and over all the holy vessels, and over the flour, the wine, the oil, the incense, and the fragrant spices.

o: Někteří také synové kněžští strojili masti z těch vonných věcí.
t: And some of the sons of the priests made ointments of the fragrant spices.

o: Matatiáš pak z Levítů, prvorozený Salluma Choritského, správcí byl těch věcí, kteréž se na pánvi smažily.
t: And Mattathias of the Levites, the firstborn of Shallum of the Horevites, was the steward of those things that were fried on the pan.

o: A z synů Kahat, z bratří jejich, byli ustanoveni nad chlebem předložení, aby jej připravovali na každou sobotu.
t: And of the sons of Kohath, of their brothers, were appointed over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

o: Z těch také byli zpěváci, přednější z čeledí otcovských mezi Levíty bydlíce, nejsouce zaměstknaní něčím jiným; nebo ve dne i v noci k své povinnosti státi musili.
t: And some of them were singers, the foremost of the families of the fathers of the Levites, dwelling in Jerusalem, not being employed in any other work; for by day and by night they were obliged to stand at their duty.

o: Ti jsou přední z čeledí otcovských mezi Levíty v čeledech svých, a ti přední jsouce, bydlili v Jeruzalémě.
t: These are the chief of the families of the fathers of the Levites, in their generations; and these chief men, dwelling in Jerusalem.

o: V Gabaon pak bydlili, otec Gabaonitských Jehiel, a jméno manželky jeho Maacha.
t: And in Gibeon dwelt Jehiel, the father of the Gibeonites, and the name of his wife was Maachah.

o: Syn pak jeho prvorozený Abdon, Zur, Cis, Bál, Ner a Nádab.
t: And his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Cis, Baal, Ner, and Nadab.

o: Ale Gedor, Achio, Zachariáš a Miklot,
t: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

o: (Miklot pak zplodil Simam), ti také naproti bratřím svým bydlili v Jeruzalémě s bratřími svými.
t: (And Mikloth begat Shimeam), these also dwelt over against their brethren in Jerusalem, with their brethren.

o: Ner pak zplodil Cisa, a Cis zplodil Saule, Saul pak zplodil Jonatu, Melchisua, Abinadaba a Ezbále.
t: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, Melchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

o: Syn pak Jonatův Meribbál, a Meribbál zplodil Mícha.
t: And Jonathan's son begat Meribbaal, and Meribbaal begat Micah.

o: Synové pak Míchovi: Piton, Melech, Tarea.
t: And the sons of Micah: Pthon, Melech, and Tarea.

o: Achaz pak zplodil Járu, Jára pak zplodil Alemeta, Azmaveta a Zimri. Zimri pak zplodil Mozu.
t: And Ahaz begat Jarah, and Jarah begat Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. And Zimri begat Moza.

o: Moza pak zplodil Bina. Refaiáš syn jeho, Elasa syn jeho, Azel syn jeho.
t: And Moza begat Binea; and Binea begat Rephaiah, his son; and Eleashah his son; and Azel his son.

o: Azel pak měl šest synů, jichžto tato jsou jména: Azrikam, Bochru, Izmael, Seariáš, Abdiáš a Chanan. Ti jsou synové Azelovi.
t: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bochor, Ishmael, Sheariah, Abdiash, and Chanan. These are the sons of Azel.

o: Když pak bojovali Filistinští s Izraelem, utíkali muži Izraelští před Filistinskými, a padli, zbiti jsouce na hoře Gelboe.
t: Now when the Philistines fought against Israel, the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down, and were slain on Mount Gilboa.

o: I stihali Filistinští Saule a syny jeho, a zabili Filistinští Jonatu, Abinadaba a Melchisua, syny Saulovy.
t: And the Philistines pursued Saul and his sons, and the Philistines slew Jonathan, Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's sons.

o: A když se zsilila bitva proti Saulovi, trefili na něj střelci s luky, a postřelen jest od střelců.
t: And when the battle grew strong against Saul, the archers shot at him, and he was wounded by the archers.

o: Protož řekl Saul oděnci svému: Vytrhni meč svůj a probodni mne jím, aby přijdouce ti neobřezanci, nečinili sobě ze mne posměchu. Ale nechtěl oděnec jeho, nebo se bál velmi. A pochytiv Saul meč, nalehl na něj.
t: Therefore Saul said to his armour-bearer: Draw forth thy sword, and thrust me through with it, that the uncircumcised may not make a mock of me. But his armour-bearer would not, for he was greatly afraid. And Saul took the sword, and fell upon it.

o: Tedy vida oděnec jeho, že umřel Saul, nalehl i on na meč a umřel.
t: And when his armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell upon the sword also, and died.

o: A tak umřel Saul i tři synové jeho, a všecka čeled jeho spolu zemřeli.
t: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house together.

o: Když pak uzřeli všickni muži Izraelští, kteříž bydlili za tím údolím, že utekli Izraelští, a že zemřeli Saul i synové jeho, opustivše města svá, též utíkali. I přišli Filistinští a bydlili v nich.
t: And when all the men of Israel that dwelt in the valley beyond the valley saw that the men of Israel had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they left their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

o: Potom nazejtří přišli Filistinští, aby zloupili pobité. I nalezli Saule a syny jeho, ležící na hoře Gelboe.
t: Then the Philistines came up to plunder the slain. And they found Saul and his sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

o: A svlékše ho, vzali hlavu jeho i odění jeho, a poslali po zemi Filistinské vůkol, aby to ohlášeno bylo modlám jejich i lidu.
t: And they stripped him, and took his head and his armor, and sent them round about the land of the Philistines to have it announced to their gods and to the people.

o: Složili také i odění jeho v chrámě boha svého, hlavu pak jeho přibili v chrámě Dágon.
t: And they put his armor in the temple of their god, and his head they nailed up in the temple of Dagon.

o: Tedy uslyšavše všickni v Jábes Galád všecko, což učinili Filistinští Saulovi,
t: Therefore when all in Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

o: Zdvihli se všickni muži silní a vzali tělo Saulovo, a těla synů jeho, a přinesli je doJábes. A pochovavše kosti jejich pod jedním dubem v Jábes, postili se sedm dní.
t: all the valiant men rose up and took the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under a great tree at Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.

o: A tak umřel Saul pro přestoupení své, jímž byl přestoupil proti Hospodinu, totiž proti slovu Hospodinovu, jehož neostříhal, a že se také radil s duchem věštím, doptávaje se ho,
t: So Saul died for his trespass, by which he had trespassed against the Lord, against the word of the Lord which he did not keep; and also because he consulted a spirit of divination, and inquired of it,

o: A nedoptával se Hospodina. Protož zabil jej, a přenesl království na Davida syna Izai.
t: and did not inquire of the Lord. Therefore he killed him, and transferred the kingdom to David the son of Jesse.

o: Nebo shromáždivše se všickni Izraelští k Davidovi do Hebronu, řekli: Aj, my kost tvá a tělo tvé jsme.
t: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David at Hebron, and said: Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

o: Ano předešlých časů, když byl Saul králem, ty jsi vyvodil i přivodil Izraele, a nadto řekl Hospodin Bůh tvůj tobě: Ty pásti budeš lid můj Izraelský, a ty budeš vývoda nad lidem mým Izraelským.
t: For in former times, when Saul was king, you led out and brought in Israel; and moreover the Lord your God said to you: You shall shepherd my people Israel, and you shall be ruler over my people Israel.

o: Přišli také všickni starší Izraelští k králi do Hebronu, a učinil s nimi David smlouvu v Hebronu před Hospodinem. I pomazali Davida za krále nad Izraelem, podlé slova Hospodinova skrze Samuele.
t: Also all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord. And they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord through Samuel.

o: Táhl pak David a všecken lid Izraelský k Jeruzalému, (jenž bylo Jebus, nebo tam byli Jebuzejští obyvatelé té země).
t: And David went with all the people of Israel to Jerusalem (which was Jebus, where there were Jebusites, the inhabitants of that land).

o: I mluvili obyvatelé Jebus Davidovi: Nevejdeš sem. Ale David vzal hrad Sion, to jest město Davidovo.
t: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David: You shall not come here. But David took the stronghold of Zion, that is, the city of David.

o: Nebo byl řekl David: Kdož by koli nejprvé porazil Jebuzea, bude předním a knížetem. Protož vstoupil nejprvé Joáb syn Sarvie, a učiněn předním.
t: For David had said: Whoever shall first strike the Jebusite shall be chief and prince. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

o: Potom bydlil David na tom hradě, pročež nazvali jej městem Davidovým.
t: Then David dwelt in that stronghold, and therefore they called it the city of David.

o: I vystavěl město vůkol a vůkol, od Mello až do okolku, Joáb pak opravil ostatek města.
t: And he built the city round about, from Millo even to the outmost parts; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

o: A tak David čím dále tím více prospíval a rostl; nebo Hospodin zástupů byl s ním.
t: And David grew more and more prosperous, and the Lord of hosts was with him.

o: Tito pak jsou přední z udatných, kteréž měl David, ježto se zmužile přičinili s ním o království jeho se vším Izraelem, aby ho za krále vyzdvihli podlé slova Hospodinova nad Izraelem.
t: These are the chief men of the mighty ones whom David had, who showed themselves valiant with him in his kingdom, to make him king over all Israel, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

o: Tento jest počet silných, kteréž měl David: Jasobam syn Chachmonův, přední z vůdců. Ten pozdvihl kopí svého proti třem stům, a zbil je pojednou.
t: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the officers. He lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them at once.

o: Po něm též Eleazar syn Dodi Achochitského. On byl jeden z těch tří udatných.
t: And after him Eleazar the son of Dodai the Ahohite; he was one of the three mighty men.

o: Ten byl s Davidem v Pasdammim, když se Filistinští sebrali k boji. A byl tu díl rolí poseté ječmenem, a lid byl utekl před Filistinskými.
t: He was with David at Pasdammin, when the Philistines gathered together to battle. And there was a plot of land full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

o: I zastavili se u prostřed toho dílu, a obdrželi jej, porazivše Filistinské. A vysvobodil Hospodin lid vysvobozením velikým.
t: And they made a stand in the midst of that plot, and took it, and smote the Philistines. And the Lord saved the people with a great deliverance.

o: Ti také tři ze třidcíti předních sstoupili k skále k Davidovi do jeskyně Adulam, když vojsko Filistinských leželo v údolí Refaim.
